fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on government neglect and a proposed monument for victims of the 1928 Lake Okeechobee storm; criticism of Dade County coroner’s inquests and justice-of-the-peace jury practices; discussion of Florida automobile taxes and traffic accidents; notes on Miami’s winter season opening and tourism, calls for a fireboat for yacht protection, and local police uniform costs. Columns and items mention “Pop” Lehman taking office as sheriff, Miami Beach Kennel Club greyhound racing, the Pan-American Air Meet, prohibition enforcement, and assorted society/entertainment notices, poems, and advertisements.
